title: Extract per-i_LS shift tables from 3GPP TS 38.212 for BG1/BG2
description:
## Problem

Our BG1 and BG2 base graph modules (`bg1.rs`, `bg2.rs`) stored a **single set** of shift values V_{i,j}. The 3GPP TS 38.212 standard (Tables 5.3.2-2 and 5.3.2-3) defines **8 different sets**, one per lifting set index i_LS (0–7). Fixed by extracting per-i_LS tables from srsRAN reference (3GPP standardized data).

## Remaining review findings

1. **Missing regression test vectors**: Create our OWN test vectors by encoding known messages with our corrected encoder. Store as constants. Validate encode roundtrip and noiseless decode.
2. **Duplicated logic**: bg1/bg2 base_matrix functions share copy-pasted i_LS lookup + mod-reduction. Extract shared helper.
3. **Missing doc comments**: `# Examples`, `# Complexity`, `# Panics` on public functions.

## Success Criteria

- [x] bg1_base_matrix(z) and bg2_base_matrix(z) select V_{i,j} by i_LS
- [x] All existing tests pass
- [ ] Regression test vectors created from our encoder for all 6 target codes
- [ ] Noiseless encode/decode roundtrip passes for all regression vectors
- [ ] Shared helper eliminates bg1/bg2 code duplication
- [ ] Doc comments complete on public functions
